untertitel: Eine Geschichte erzählen – mit den Wörtern aus Unit 4

hilfe.text: Geschichten erzählt man im simple past. Wörter wie first, then, after that und in the end zeigen die Reihenfolge.

stufen.kurz: Jack went to the charity shop …
stufen.anweisung: Setze das Verb im simple past ein.

aufgaben.frage: Bring die Geschichte in die richtige Reihenfolge.
teile: First Jack went to the charity shop.
Then he found an old dress.
In the end his sister loved it!
aufgaben.loesung: First Jack went to the charity shop. Then he found an old dress. He paid five pounds. In the end his sister loved it!

aufgaben.frage: Bring die Geschichte in die richtige Reihenfolge.
teile: Then we saw lots of old stuff.
After that we paid for a magazine.
In the end we went home.
aufgaben.loesung: First we opened the door. Then we saw lots of old stuff. After that we paid for a magazine. In the end we went home.
aufgaben.tipp: first – then – after that – in the end

aufgaben.frage: Bring die Geschichte in die richtige Reihenfolge.
teile: Then she got her pocket money.
After that she bought a new magazine.
In the end she read it on the sofa.
aufgaben.loesung: First Mia did her chores. Then she got her pocket money. After that she bought a new magazine. In the end she read it on the sofa.
aufgaben.tipp: first – then – after that – in the end
